tha-ap419:1.1: Ucchaṅgapupphiya.] Nagare Bandhumatiyā ahosiṃ māliko tadā / ucchaṅgaṃ pūrayitvāna āgamam antarāpaṇaṃ. // //
tha-ap419:2.1: Bhagavā ca tamhi samaye bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato / mahatā ānubhāvena niyyāti lokanāyako. // //
tha-ap419:3.1: Disvāna lokapajjotaṃ Vipassiṃ lokatāraṇaṃ / pupphaṃ paggayha ucchaṅgā Buddhaseṭṭham apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap419:4.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap419:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ucchaṅgapupphiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
